recentItems.title: Possible extended dry El Niño season a major concern for the sector: AgriSA CEO
recentItems.description:
Countries in the Southern African Development Community could face a sharper food-security shock. 

There are concern that the onset of a strong El Niño may hold dire consequences for conservation, agriculture and water security in South Africa.

Climate models are showing that the conditions arising from El Niño are likely to peak between October and December, persisting into early next year. 

Agriculture is among the sectors most vulnerable to El Niño. Reduced rainfall during planting seasons can substantially decrease maize, sunflower and soya bean production, among others. AgriSA CEO Johann Kotze joins us to discuss this further

recentItems.title: Former 'Bok captain John Smit and All Blacks captain Richie McCaw on Siya Kolisi's leadership style
recentItems.description:
Siya Kolisi's leadership style is defined by humility, shared responsibility and leading by example. 

As the captain of South Africa's national rugby team, the Springboks, he made history by leading the team to back-to-back Rugby World Cup titles in 2019 and 2023. 

His approach moves away from the old idea of a captain. Instead, he uses a style that brings people together and makes the whole team stronger.

SABC News senior sports reporter Thando Mxoli spoke to former Springbok Captain John Smit and former All Black captain Richie McCaw on the importance of Kolisi's presence and leadership to the world champions.
